t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes of all colours appeared friendly. I alternated between colours. Immediately we were in the forest. The forest changed colours, sometimes a bright green, sometimes a yellow/autumn colours. I pressed the spacebar rapidly, even though I couldn't immediately see the mushrooms, as otherwise I was chided as being too slow. The mushrooms appeared out of nowhere. I have since read a script written by a previous player, who has advised me that the gnomes appear in colour pairs, and the previous player also advised of the best colours to choose from between the gnomes. The previous player also advised on the best colour basket to have, but I do not have a choice of basket, so that is immaterial. I will try out the previous player's advice, and watch and see what happens next.

vb_textbox.text: Hello fellow participant! I hope you enjoy the game :) Basically, the gnomes are in eight colours, split into two teams. The yellow basket team and the red basket team. The Yellow, orange, blue & green hatted gnomes belong to the yellow basket. If you choose one of those four colours, you will be presented with a yellow basket on the next screen. The red basket team are Red, pink, purple and brown hatted gnomes. Now, I had previously been advised by another previous participant that the yellow basket team tended to yield the best results. However, on several occasions I chose from the yellow basket team, and found zero mushrooms. The most mushrooms I found were 45, but the majority tended to average around 9 - 15 mushrooms. Whether the red basket team would have yielded higher results is a matter of conjecture. I did from time to time try the gnomes on the red basket team; those results appeared in my view to be just as random. Basically, I kept mainly to the advice I had received from a previous participant, but the resulting mushroom hunts produced varying amounts of mushrooms and it's impossible to tell whether or not the red basket team would have produced very different scores. I suspect not. The game felt fairly random. You go ahead and experiment & see what your results are, it's still a fun game!
